title: Can image style transfer be performed with k-nearest neighbours?
question: Can image style transfer be performed with k-nearest neighbours, using a set of multiple reference images in a RAG-like architecture and an input image, without specific finetuning on particular styles?
answer: Yes it can! Here is an approach on this topic from 2022: "Neural Neighbor Style Transfer" https://arxiv.org/pdf/2203.13215 And a more recent work building off of it: "Image Realism Enhancement Method Based on Improved Neural Neighbor Style Transfer" https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10865483 Related to the idea of Nearest Neighbors, this work uses neighbors to form a graph and apply a GNN, and is also very related: "Learning Graph Neural Networks for Image Style Transfer" https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-20071-7_7
